part: 6 - external label ansc_upheld from the manual review
disclaimer_ru: Индикатор потенциального риска, а не доказательство коррупции/нарушения. Требуется проверка компетентным органом. Удовлетворённая жалоба ANSC не является доказательством коррупции.
disclaimer_en: An upheld ANSC complaint indicates an administrative procurement dispute outcome and does not constitute proof of corruption.

procedure_level.rule: labels stay at document/complaint level; no procedure collapses them into one binary value

decision_dates.rule: a label may only enter a model as of a date AFTER the decision date of its document; features dated before the decision would be future leakage

note: labels derive from the human review only; upheld != proof of corruption; ansc_upheld is an EXTERNAL label and must never become a model feature
